narrative.benchmark_md: Bank of Utah outperforms peer median in 3/4 pillars and 12/17 categories. Agentforce opportunity is greenfield [E-105:F1] - no peer has deployed AI agents.
narrative.scqa_md:
Bank of Utah is a $3.7B in assets regional bank regulated by FDIC (state-chartered, FDIC-supervised), operating since 1952 with 459 employees. A 5.1% multi-year growth rate gives it the balance sheet to fund transformation [E-019, E-022]. Zennify's assessment places overall digital maturity at 2.7/5. The deepest capability gap is Automation Strategy & Governance at 2.3/5 against a 2.5 peer median [E-070, E-078].

Next is Decision Rights Framework at 2.5/5 against a 3.0 peer median [E-015, E-055]. Third is Compliance Reporting at 2.5/5 against a 3.0 peer median [E-073, E-081]. Counter-signal: Innovation Horizons already runs at 3.3/5 against a 2.5 peer median — a strength to build on, not rebuild. The roster shows no CTO / CIO — a named ownership gap for the capabilities below.

The question for Bank of Utah is whether to close Automation Strategy & Governance first — the constraint the other investments inherit — or continue layering point solutions on top of it and accept the compounding operating cost. Bank of Utah should lead with Tableau (46/100 fit) against Service Segmentation & Tiers, then sequence Twilio behind it. Closing Automation Strategy & Governance to the peer median alone is worth 0.2 maturity points, and the capabilities that depend on it compound the gain. The analyst's own priority framing: "Q2+Stablecore digital asset partnership (March 2026) — First mover in digital custody for community banks.

Innovation signal but regulatory risk…".
